Anna and Sam are preparing a report about the volunteer team. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Sam is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. Best of all, she looks down on no one.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sam thanked Anna for the honest advice. On Friday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. Her close friends list has nine people.

The club room has become an important part of daily life. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Her unrealized dream of acting finally came true at sixty.

Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Sam often share different ideas about the volunteer team. Save the date for the wedding.
Sam's dream job is to be a driver. Little by little, things began to change. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit.
